jobs.occupation: ERP Integration Lead (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role:

As the ERP Integration Lead for the our Life Science business, you will lead the governance, design, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting our global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, the ERP Design and Build organization, the Deployment Leads, Integrated Enterprise Solutions as well as our implementation partners, you will drive the delivery of scalable, standardized, secure, and compliant integrations between SAP S/4HANA and connected business applications. You will provide technical leadership throughout the integration lifecycle from architecture and solution design through implementation, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a robust and resilient integration landscape that enables successful global deployments while preserving enterprise architecture principles and clean core standards.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Integration function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting the global ERP template.
- Define and govern enterprise integration principles, interface standards, API strategies, middleware architecture, and integration patterns across SAP and connected business applications.
- Govern technical integration decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, clean core strategy, and global technology standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of application integrations across functional workstreams and implementation partners.
- Ensure integration consistency and technical solution integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable technical deployment readiness, interface validation, cutover planning, technical issue resolution, and successful deployment execution.
- Collaborate with ERP Design and Build, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Manufacturing, and other technology teams to deliver an integrated enterprise solution.
- Ensure application integrations are designed, built, tested, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements, and global quality standards by partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployments into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for integration readiness, interface testing, technical defect resolution, deployment preparation, and cutover activities across all integrated applications.
- Identify technical risks, interface dependencies, and architectural constraints early and proactively manage mitigation plans to support successful program delivery.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, SAP, and technology vendors while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, event driven architecture, and emerging SAP technologies to continuously improve the enterprise integration landscape and accelerate future deployments.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 10 or more years of experience leading SAP integration, enterprise application integration, or large scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
- Extensive experience designing and governing enterprise application integration landscapes supporting SAP and non SAP business applications.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA technical architecture, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, middleware technologies, and modern enterprise integration patterns.
- Proven leadership experience managing global technical teams and implementation partners across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Strong knowledge of enterprise integration governance, enterprise architecture, clean core principles, cybersecurity, and SAP implementation methodologies.
- Demonstrated experience leading integration solution delivery in GxP regulated Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
- Deep understanding of deployment readiness, integration testing, interface validation, technical cutover planning, and transition from build to deployment.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and IT leaders across global organizations.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance technology strategy, business value, operational stability, risk, and delivery timelines.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross functional teams without direct authority in a matrix organization.
- Experience leading multiple concurrent initiatives within a global ERP transformation program.
- Fluent in English. German or another European language is considered an advantage.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in Germany.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

As Project Lead for Network Detection & Response Evaluation, you will drive the selection and proof of concept validation of an Network Detection & Response solution and ensure it fits our Security Operations Center operating model and technical landscape. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, define success criteria, manage risks (e.g., performance, integration, compliance), and deliver a decision-ready recommendation including a roadmap from PoC to operational rollout.

Your tasks include the folliwing responsibilities:

- Leading the structured evaluation and selection of a Network Detection and Response solution, including requirements definition, vendor comparison, and decision preparation
- Planning and executing a proof of concept to validate detection capabilities, operational fit, and technical feasibility in a Security Operations Center environment
- Defining and aligning target use cases and success criteria for network-based threat detection and response, focusing on visibility gaps and anomaly detection
- Driving the integration concept into existing Security Operations Center tooling and processes, ensuring alignment with monitoring, investigation, and response workflows
- Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across cyber security, infrastructure, and network domains to ensure alignment on architecture, data sources, and deployment approach
- Evaluating the reuse and integration of existing network telemetry and sensor data to optimize cost, complexity, and time-to-value
- Developing and documenting a target operating model for network-based threat detection and response within cyber security operations
- Identifying and managing key project risks, including performance impact, integration complexity, resource constraints, and data protection requirements
- Preparing management-ready recommendations, including solution comparison, risk assessment, and roadmap towards implementation and operationalization

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in a related field or comparable qualification
- Proven experience in leading cyber security or information technology projects on enterprise level, ideally in evaluation or implementation of detection and monitoring capabilities.
- Strong understanding of network-based threat detection and response principles, including behavioral analytics and anomaly detection approaches.
- Practical knowledge of enterprise network environments and data sources within large-scale enterprise environments, such as network flow data and traffic analysis approaches.
- Experience working with Security Operations Center environments and related platforms, including monitoring, alerting, and incident handling processes.
- Demonstrated ability to design and execute structured evaluation processes and proof of concepts with clear success criteria.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant recommendations.
- Solid understanding of compliance, governance, and data protection requirements in cyber security contexts
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)

Advantageous

- Experience in integrating detection and monitoring solutions into complex enterprise environments, including cross-domain architectures.
- Background in threat hunting, detection engineering, or incident response.
- Familiarity with network and endpoint security technologies and their interaction within a holistic security architecture.
- Experience in environments combining information technology and operational technology with specific monitoring requirements.
- Relevant certifications in project management or cyber security.

Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an ASIC Layout Engineer (m/f/diverse) for AESS (Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions), you will be responsible for the top-level integration of analog and mixed-signal ICs. You will drive the layout development process, ensuring robust, DRC-compliant designs with optimal area utilization. You will collaborate closely with analog circuit designers and other layout engineers to deliver high-quality silicon.

Key Responsibilities

- Drive the top-level layout integration of analog/mixed-signal chips (analog on top)
- Define toplevel floorplan, padframe design and bonding diagrams in coordination with other domains
- Coordinate with other layouters to define floorplans according to the chip top level
- Generate and integrate analog layouts at block and chip level
- Perform pin placement, parasitic extraction, and layout optimization
- Ensure compliance with DRC, LVS, and support tape-out activities
- Collaborate with design engineers to meet speed, area, power, DFM, ESD, and EMC requirements

Qualifications

- Academic degree in Electronics Engineering or related field
- Extensive professional experience in analog layout design
- Proven experience in top-level layout integration
- Strong expertise in BCD technologies (65nm to 180nm)
- Deep understanding of deep submicron effects (parasitics, coupling, matching)
- Proficient in layout tools for design, DRC, LVS, and extraction
- Knowledge of analog circuit design
- Fluent English language skills (both written and spoken), German language skills are a plus
